notes.title: Free for all
notes.content: The game will be available for free very soon. If you suddenly find yourself here by chance, do not buy it, but wait for the free version)

notes.title: Pre-release preparation
notes.content:
Hello guys!

I added a few new mechanics to the game. Also added viewing controls in the main menu and the ability to play from the keyboard.
So if you do not have a joystick, or less than 4 joysticks, then you can still play with friends.

The game will be released approximately at the end of July.
